metadata.title: NasalSeg Dataset for Nasal Cavity and Paranasal Sinuses Segmentation from CT Images
metadata.description: NasalSeg is the first large-scale, open-access dataset for nasal cavity and paranasal sinus segmentation from 3D CT images. The dataset comprises 130 CT scans with pixel-wise annotation of five anatomical structures including the left nasal cavity, right nasal cavity, nasal pharynx, left maxillary sinus, and right maxillary sinu.
